name: dso_target_cash_release
question_template: Annual credit sales are {CREDIT_SALES} USD. Accounts receivable were {RECV_BEGIN} USD at the beginning of the year and {RECV_END} USD at the end. Use the arithmetic mean of beginning and ending receivables and a 365-day year. Management targets days sales outstanding of {TARGET_DSO} days with credit sales unchanged. Compute the cash released from receivables if the target is met: current average receivables minus the receivables level implied by the target. A negative value means receivables would have to rise. Use exact arithmetic.

slots.description: Arithmetic mean of beginning and ending receivables in USD.
Credit sales divided by average receivables.
Current days sales outstanding on a 365-day year.
Receivables level implied by the target days in USD.

program:
def solve():
    S = Fraction(P["CREDIT_SALES"])
    rb = Fraction(P["RECV_BEGIN"])
    re = Fraction(P["RECV_END"])
    T = Fraction(P["TARGET_DSO"])
    avg = (rb + re) / 2
    if avg <= 0 or S <= 0:
        raise ValueError("non-positive inputs")
    turnover = S / avg
    dso = Fraction(365) / turnover
    target = S * T / Fraction(365)
    final = avg - target
    return {
        "final": final,
        "avg_receivables": avg,
        "receivables_turnover": turnover,
        "current_dso": dso,
        "target_receivables": target,
    }
